meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 探索代码时会先做结构索引:用 AST 解析返回排序的符号列表、文件大纲和折叠视图,再只展开你要的那个函数/类方法。它不再用读全文的方式翻代码,而是给出小而准的代码片段。
howto.when: 当 Claude 需要理解代码结构、查找某个函数,或高效探索代码库时触发。典型如你让它定位一个功能或符号的实现位置。

say.text: 在 src 目录里搜 shutdown 相关函数,先给我看符号列表。
say.note: 返回排序后的符号和所在文件概览。

say.text: 先别读整个文件,给我 worker-service.ts 的结构大纲。
say.note: 只展示函数和类的骨架。

say.text: 展开 performGracefulShutdown 函数,给我完整源码。
say.note: smart_unfold 返回该符号的完整实现。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude explores code via AST-based structural search instead of reading whole files: it returns ranked symbol lists and file outlines, then unfolds only the chosen symbol's full source.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude needs to understand code structure, locate functions, or browse a codebase efficiently — e.g., when asked to find where a feature/symbol is implemented.

say_en.text: Search src for shutdown-related functions and show the symbol list.
Don't read the whole file; give me an outline of worker-service.ts.
Unfold the performGracefulShutdown function and show full source.
